Fictional scenario: 2026-09-01 morning shift. Trainee operator Xiao Lin verifies the records for P-03 to T-2 under the shift lead's supervision; the handing-over party is previous shift operator Xiao Zhou, and the receiving duty officer is Xiao Chen. Paper practice only, with no equipment connection; no safety limits or start-stop permits are provided.

A1 handover form: 08:00, equipment P-03, planned transfer of 10 m³ to T-2. The medium name, source container, valve position confirmation, and receiving party confirmation are all blank; the actual cumulative transfer volume is not filled in.

A2 instantaneous readings: 08:00 pressure 0.20 MPa and flow 40 m³/h; 08:10 both pressure and flow blank; 08:20 pressure 0.24 MPa and flow 42 m³/h. There is no continuous trend, cumulative volume, level, or alarm record. The above are hypothetical observations only and cannot be used to judge safety.
Tasks and deliverables

First independently list the known and unknown items of A1/A2 and label each with its data reference number; write an abnormality record and handover summary as of 08:20. Do not derive the cumulative volume, do not fill in valve positions, media, or readings, and do not issue start-stop instructions.

Reference approach (complete it independently first)

Reference verification: A1 confirms only P-03, T-2, and the planned 10 m³; the medium, source, valve positions, and receiving confirmation are unknown. A2 is missing the two 08:10 readings; the two known time points differ by 0.04 MPa in pressure and 2 m³/h in flow, but this cannot prove a continuous rise during the interval, an actual transfer of 10 m³, or equipment safety.

Reference handover: as of 08:20, the four confirmations in A1 and the actual cumulative volume are still missing, and A2 is missing the 08:10 pressure/flow. Submit the original A1/A2 to the shift lead for verification, ask Xiao Zhou to add the original handover basis and Xiao Chen to confirm the receiving information; before confirmation, do not write the planned quantity as completed and do not approve operations on your own based on the readings.

subject.name: Pump Operators, Except Wellhead Pumpers
subject.summary: Pump operators, except wellhead pumpers, operate stationary or mobile pumps and manifolds to transfer gases, oils, liquids, slurries, or powders between tanks, pipelines, and process equipment. The work includes verifying valve positions and transfer routes, monitoring levels and pressures, recording transfer volumes and abnormalities, and handling or reporting abnormalities per site procedures. This page defines the occupation according to US O*NET 53-7072.00; Chinese job titles and safety requirements must be verified separately by employer, process, and local regulations.
